prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Transparent game sprite sheet of approved KPop RIGHT girl in image1. Preserve long coral-pink side-parted hair, warm fair skin, amber eyes, navy-blue shirt with pink/lilac swirl motifs and striped sleeve trim, yellow-gold pleated skirt, blue knee-high boots with pink heart/shield knee panels. Human anatomy exactly2arms2legs, no animal ears or tail. Exact approved outfit/colors. Exactly EIGHT full-body poses, four columns and two rows, read left to right then next row. Consistent head size, clean navy outlines/cel shading, camera three-quarter facing RIGHT, generous transparent gutters all sides, all hair/clothing/feet/raised hands completely inside each cell. ROW1: 1 tug-of-war ready: feet planted, torso leaning BACK to left, both EMPTY gripping hands held together out FRONT to right at waist height, determined happy grin; 2 tug heave: leaning farther BACK left, knees bent, same forward empty rope grip, cheerful exertion; 3 fishing reel ready: leaning back slightly, near hand gripping an invisible rod just above chest height forward right, other hand beside it preparing to crank, happy focused gaze right; 4 fishing reel crank: same planted feet and forward gripping hand, other hand moved inward/down to crank invisible reel, bright grin. ROW2: 5 overhead bat-swing windup: both EMPTY gripping hands together over right shoulder/above head, legs braced, gleeful face; 6 bat-swing followthrough: both empty hands moved FORWARD right and upward above face, gentle overhead strike finished, cheerful grin; 7 putting ready: side-on facing right, knees softly bent, looking down-right, BOTH empty gripping hands low together forward right at thigh height holding an INVISIBLE putter; 8 putting followthrough: same stance, low empty hands swung slightly forward right, looking up-right hopefully. Do not draw rope, rod, fishing line, bat, putter, balls, scenery, shadows, ground, words, labels or effects. Transparent background. Keep VERY generous transparent margins around all hair and boots, including lastcolumn rightedge; no silhouette may touch any sheetedge.
cropMethod: Largest alpha>=32 connected figure bounds, A clustered into top4/bottom4 then sorted left-to-right, B sorted left-to-right; expanded5px and builder alpha-isolation preserves full flowing hair/fingers/boots.
